what: The list rolls up one row at a time every 1.2s inside the window (four visible rows) — it overshoots slightly and settles with .45s back.out(1.7). The bottom row is the current one (↳ in the number slot), and rows fade going up at 1 · .85 · .6 · .25. At the end it continues into the cloned first row for a seamless loop, and it pauses when offscreen

options.dur: Roll duration per slot (sec), default .45 (0 is instant)
options.fade: Values that fade toward the top (comma-separated), default 1,.85,.6,.25
options.[data-fx-part=item]: List row (child). Row height is measured from the first line
options.[data-fx-part=index]: (optional) number within a row — this row uses ↳ instead of a number

from.where: index.html .wwd__reel — twelve service lines of What We Do (original stepInterval 1.2 · transitionDuration .45 · back.out(1.7))
